blocks.text: t-SNE offered genuinely powerful visualization capability, but carried real, honest limitations, slow on large datasets, and genuinely unable to project new, unseen data at all. UMAP, Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection, is a genuinely more modern alternative, built specifically to address several of those exact real limitations while keeping the genuine nonlinear, visualization focused strength that made t-SNE valuable in the first place.

This topic covers how UMAP genuinely preserves both local and some real global structure, unlike t-SNE purely local focus, its genuine, considerable speed advantage, a real, meaningful capability t-SNE fundamentally lacks, projecting brand new data directly, the key hyperparameters that shape its output, the separate library required to actually use it, and an honest, nuanced take on how much its interpretation caution genuinely differs from t-SNE.
1. Preserving Both Local and Global Structure

blocks.alt: Preserving Both Local and Global Structure
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423614-776944256.png

t-SNE, covered in the previous topic, genuinely optimizes almost entirely for local neighborhood structure, which is exactly why the distance between separate clusters in a t-SNE plot was flagged as genuinely unreliable. UMAP genuinely takes a different, more balanced mathematical approach, preserving local neighborhoods while also retaining genuinely more of the real, overall global relationships between different regions of the data.

This is a genuinely real, meaningful improvement, a UMAP plot genuine cluster positioning tends to carry more real, trustworthy information about how different groups actually relate to each other than a t-SNE plot typically does, though, as covered later in this topic, this improvement is genuinely real but not absolute.
2. A Genuine, Considerable Speed Advantage
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423614-770170226.png

UMAP is genuinely, considerably faster than t-SNE on the same data, particularly as dataset size grows large, a real, practical difference that matters directly for genuinely large, real world datasets where t-SNE can become impractically slow to run at all. This speed advantage comes from genuine differences in the underlying mathematical approach, not from any shortcut that sacrifices real result quality.
This real, practical speed difference is often, on its own, enough reason to reach for UMAP over t-SNE by default in a real project, especially one involving genuinely large amounts of data.
3. A Worked Example
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423919-744829862.png
Applying UMAP to the exact same small dataset used in the previous t-SNE topic shows this technique in direct, comparable use.

code.content:
import umap
import pandas as pd

X = pd.DataFrame({
    "square_feet": [900, 1200, 1500, 1800, 2100, 2400, 950, 2450],
    "bedrooms": [2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 2, 5],
    "location_score": [3, 5, 4, 8, 7, 9, 3, 9],
})

reducer = umap.UMAP(n_neighbors=3, min_dist=0.1, random_state=42)
embedding = reducer.fit_transform(X)

print(embedding)

blocks.text: The genuine interface here looks almost identical to the t-SNE worked example in the previous topic, fit_transform producing a 2D embedding directly, but genuinely computed considerably faster underneath, and, as the next section covers, genuinely capable of handling new data that t-SNE fundamentally cannot.

blocks.text: 4. A Real, Genuine Capability t-SNE Lacks: Projecting New Data

blocks.alt: A Real, Genuine Capability t-SNE Lacks: Projecting New Data
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423919-884432030.png

Unlike t-SNE, which genuinely has no way to place a brand new, unseen point into an already computed embedding, UMAP genuinely can, calling transform on a fitted UMAP reducer with new data produces a genuine, consistent projection into the same embedded space. This directly resolves the real dead end limitation flagged at the end of the previous topic.

This real capability means UMAP genuinely can serve as an actual preprocessing step in a real, ongoing pipeline, feeding its output into a separate downstream model trained later, a genuine role t-SNE structurally cannot fill at all.

blocks.title: Worth remembering
blocks.content: UMAP genuine ability to project new data is precisely what makes it suitable for a real, ongoing pipeline, a role the previous topic t-SNE structurally cannot fill at all.

blocks.text: 5. The Key Hyperparameters
https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423919-427034878.png

n_neighbors genuinely controls how many neighboring points define local structure around each point, directly analogous to perplexity in t-SNE, a genuinely small value focuses tightly on very local detail, while a genuinely large value considers broader, more global structure. min_dist genuinely controls how tightly points are allowed to pack together in the final embedded space, a genuinely small value allows tight, dense clusters, while a genuinely larger value spreads points out more evenly.

Both parameters genuinely shape the resulting plot considerably, exactly like perplexity did for t-SNE, and are worth experimenting with directly on a specific, real dataset rather than trusting default values blindly.

blocks.text: 6. A Separate Library, Not Built Into scikit-learn

blocks.alt: A Separate Library, Not Built Into scikit-learn
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423920-401895990.png

Unlike PCA, SVD, LDA, and t-SNE, all genuinely available directly inside scikit-learn, UMAP genuinely requires installing a separate package, umap-learn, exactly as imported in the worked example above. This is worth knowing directly before reaching for this technique in a new environment.

Despite living in a genuinely separate library, UMAP was deliberately designed to follow the exact same familiar fit_transform interface pattern used throughout scikit-learn, making it feel genuinely consistent with everything else covered in this course, even though it technically comes from elsewhere.

blocks.title: A practical habit
blocks.content: Install umap-learn, not a package literally named umap, when setting up an environment for this technique. The import statement genuinely still reads import umap once installed correctly.

blocks.text: 7. An Honest, Nuanced Take on Interpretation Caution

blocks.alt: An Honest, Nuanced Take on Interpretation Caution
blocks.text: https://algorithmxlr8-content-media.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/diagrams/1785443423920-847532728.png

UMAP genuine improvement in preserving global structure does not mean its output should be read as a fully precise, reliable distance measure either. A UMAP plot genuinely carries somewhat more trustworthy global structure than a comparable t-SNE plot, but it is still genuinely not the same as a linear projection like PCA, where distances and directions carry a genuinely precise, well defined mathematical meaning throughout.

The genuinely honest, fair takeaway is that UMAP is a real, meaningful improvement over t-SNE specifically for global structure, not a complete, absolute fix, the same general caution about over-interpreting exact distances still applies, just to a genuinely lesser real degree.
8. UMAP Versus What Comes Next

PCA, SVD, LDA, t-SNE, and UMAP together cover the genuine range of dimensionality reduction techniques this module set out to build, linear and nonlinear, supervised and unsupervised, general purpose and visualization focused. What remains is tying every one of these genuinely different techniques together into one coherent, practical decision framework.

The next and final topic in this module, Feature Projection, does exactly that, closing out this entire module with a genuine, general synthesis of when to choose each technique, and how this entire family compares directly against the feature selection approach covered in the previous module.

items: UMAP genuinely preserves both local neighborhood structure and more real global structure than t-SNE.
It is genuinely, considerably faster than t-SNE, especially on large, real world datasets.
Unlike t-SNE, UMAP genuinely can project brand new, unseen data into an existing embedding.
n_neighbors and min_dist are the genuine key hyperparameters shaping its output, analogous to perplexity.
UMAP genuinely requires the separate umap-learn library, though it follows the familiar scikit-learn interface.
UMAP output is genuinely more trustworthy than t-SNE for global structure, but still not a fully precise distance measure.
